days.title: Today’s Rasi Palan & Horoscope, 6 November 2026: All 12 Rasis

signs.name: Mesha (Aries)
signs.text: A strong day to clear pending work, beat competition and settle disputes. Health improves with a steady routine.
signs.advice: Keep a calm tone in conversations at work.

signs.name: Vrishabha (Taurus)
signs.text: Your mind may wander and plans may face small delays. Keep away from speculation and attend to children’s needs.
signs.advice: Offer water to the Sun at sunrise for a positive start.

signs.name: Mithuna (Gemini)
signs.text: You may feel restless or tired at home. Take things slowly, look after your mother’s health and avoid arguments.
signs.advice: Avoid starting important work during Rahu kalam.

signs.name: Karka (Cancer)
signs.text: Your efforts pay off today. Short trips, calls and talks with siblings go well, and courage brings success.
signs.advice: Spend a few minutes outdoors in the morning light.

signs.name: Simha (Leo)
signs.text: Watch your words and your spending today. Money matters need patience, so avoid lending or big purchases.
signs.advice: Light a lamp at home in the evening.

signs.name: Kanya (Virgo)
signs.text: The Moon in your own sign lifts your mood and confidence. A good day to start personal tasks and spend time with family.
signs.advice: Wear something in your lucky colour today.

signs.name: Tula (Libra)
signs.text: Expenses and tiredness may rise. Rest well, avoid late nights and spend only on worthwhile things.
signs.advice: Begin the day with a short prayer or meditation.

signs.name: Vrischika (Scorpio)
signs.text: A gainful day. Expect good news, support from friends and progress in money matters.
signs.advice: Help an elder or someone in need today.

signs.name: Dhanu (Sagittarius)
signs.text: Work goes well and seniors notice your efforts. A good day for official tasks and decisions.
signs.advice: Keep a calm tone in conversations at work.

signs.name: Makara (Capricorn)
signs.text: Some obstacles slow you down, but prayer and the advice of elders help. Postpone important signatures if you can.
signs.advice: Offer water to the Sun at sunrise for a positive start.

signs.name: Kumbha (Aquarius)
signs.text: Chandrashtamam day. Stay calm, avoid new ventures and long drives, and double-check documents.
signs.advice: Avoid starting important work during Rahu kalam.

signs.name: Meena (Pisces)
signs.text: Partnerships and relationships feel warm today. Good for meetings, travel and time with your spouse.
signs.advice: Spend a few minutes outdoors in the morning light.
